formattedAddress: 106, Taiwan, Taipei City, Da’an District, Longyuan Village, Alley 2, Lane 118, Section 2, Heping E Rd, 1號1樓

text.text:
I cannot speak Chinese. Their menu translates “pork pizza” in Chinese into “smoke salmon pizza” in English, so I got the wrong pizza. We were super hungry and in a hurry so I just accepted it. I pointed out the menu mistake to them and said, I’d just take it this time. Then that’s it. No apology nor any intention to take responsibility. It doesn’t seem like they were rude or anything, it seems like they were just young part-time kids who didn’t know what a decent restaurant should do.

Note that they have a process of confirming the order with the customers. But again, I cannot understand Chinese. What’s the point …

We planned to take some home for our helper and she cannot eat pork so we had to buy sthg else for them. That pork pizza wasn’t good. It had some bone fractures in the minced pork, very disappointing. It took us 5 days to try to finish the food we didn’t like before we throw the rest away …

text.text:
Penne Bolognese: flavors of tomato and meat not integrated.  Needs to be cooked much longer.  (My homemade version is better).

Pizza: edges too crispy but the rest undercooked.  Cheese not browned.  Probably sauce is too wet.  Cheese was not evenly distributed (no cheese -> burnt)
